vendors.name: Runlayer
vendors.offering: MCP gateway, shadow-AI discovery, agent identity, session traces and governance for enterprises

vendors.name: MintMCP (Mintive)
vendors.offering: MCP gateway with OAuth/SSO, team permissions, audit trail of every MCP interaction, SIEM export
vendors.pricing: not public (per-user quote plus usage-based platform fee)

vendors.name: Permit MCP Gateway (Permit.io)
vendors.offering: Proxy authorizing each MCP tool call per agent and person, consent, trust levels, decision logs
vendors.pricing: Permit Community tier free (14-day log retention); paid tier prices not public

vendors.name: Descope Agentic Identity Hub
vendors.offering: OAuth for MCP servers, agent consent and token vault (outbound app tokens)
vendors.pricing: Free (2,000 consents/tokens); Pro from $249/mo; Growth from $799/mo; $0.05 per extra consent/token

vendors.name: Auth0 for AI Agents
vendors.offering: Auth for MCP, Token Vault for agent credentials, human confirmation of agent actions
vendors.pricing: Free plan includes Auth for MCP and Token Vault (limit 2); paid-tier add-on price not public

vendors.name: TrueFoundry MCP Gateway
vendors.offering: AI and MCP gateway with RBAC, tool approvals, virtual MCPs and audit logs
vendors.pricing: Free tier; Pro $25 per user/month incl. 20K requests, $20 per extra 100K

vendors.name: Docker MCP Enterprise Gateway
vendors.offering: Adds SSO, per-tool group policy and SIEM audit events to the free MIT gateway

vendors.name: Cloudflare MCP server portals
vendors.offering: Single Access-protected endpoint for approved MCP servers, per-portal tool curation, Logpush to SIEM
vendors.pricing: included for all Cloudflare customers; no separate price published

paid_market_gaps.gap: Leading MCP governance vendors (Runlayer, MintMCP) publish no prices and offer no self-serve; small teams cannot evaluate or buy
Free Docker MCP Gateway has one shared token; per-user access, per-tool policy and audit require a separate enterprise contract
Azure APIM v2 tiers lack tool-level MCP control; dynamic tool lists cannot be governed by Agent 365
External audit connectors and fine-grained authorization need Descope Growth ($799/mo); lower tiers keep audit 1 week-1 month

wtp_evidence: Public paid tiers (TrueFoundry $25/user/mo, Descope $249-$799/mo) and Runlayer raising $42M for enterprise MCP governance show buyers pay; post-purchase complaints not found.
bundling_note: AWS AgentCore includes Identity at no extra charge via Gateway (Policy billed per authorization), Cloudflare MCP portals are available to all customers, and Docker's gateway is free MIT.
summary: Crowded and fast-bundling: funded gateways (Runlayer, MintMCP), identity incumbents (Auth0, Descope) and clouds (AWS, Cloudflare, Microsoft) all cover it. Only a narrow wedge remains, e.g. self-serve per-agent credentials and audit for mid-market teams across clouds.
